title: Grateful Dead Live at Taft Auditorium on 1971-10-30
source: FM> Pioneer RT-707 (7" reel @ 19 ips)> CD

ai_review.summary: Solid, high‑energy Dead performance hampered by a mixed‑quality mix that buries Jerry’s guitar.
ai_review.review: Fans agree the show itself was enjoyable and energetic, with even a nod to a Truckin’ moment, but opinions on the recording diverge sharply. Some praise “great sound quality,” while others describe a muddy, low‑level mix with mic bleed and peaking that makes the set nearly unlistenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is generally positive (high energy, good performance) while recording quality receives both high and low marks; weighting the two yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviews conflict: some call it excellent, others report a bad mix with Jerry buried, mic bleed into the board, and noticeable peaking. Overall the recording is considered uneven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; reviewers focus on overall enjoyment rather than specific sequencing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised by some as great, but several reviewers note his guitar is low in the mix or “unlistenable.”
